summary: Trinity bursts out of a room into the hall just as Agent Brown enters, leading another unit of police. She immediately races to the opposite end of the hall and exits through a broken window onto the fire escape, fleeing the agents and police who have just arrived.

what_changes.before: Inside the building, briefly clear of pursuit after the fight.
what_changes.after: Escaping through a broken window onto the fire escape as Agent Brown and police arrive.
what_changes.evidence: She bursts out of the room as Agent Brown enters the hall, leading another unit of police. Trinity races to the opposite end, exiting through a broken window onto the fire escape.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity flees through the hall onto the fire escape as Agent Brown leads police into the building.

uncertain: Whether the police see Trinity before she exits through the window.
